{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1hjRVKirygVGoQvd3Ma","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01NN7MycB7ikcG8s59FCT3S3","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/matmul_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r5/matmul/matmul.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Generate pseudo-random values for matrix initialization\nconstexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {\n    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);\n}\n\n// Fills `rowCount` rows of an N-column matrix starting at global row `rowStart`\nvoid initMatrix(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N, const size_t rowStart, const size_t rowCount) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[i * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, rowStart + i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Row-block distribution: rank r owns rows [start, start + count) of C\nstruct RowBlock {\n    size_t start;\n    size_t count;\n};\n\nRowBlock rowBlock(const size_t N, const int rank, const int size) {\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    const size_t base = N / p;\n    const size_t rem = N % p;\n    return {r * base + std::min(r, rem), base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0)};\n}\n\n// Computes C = A * B for the local `rows` rows of A (rows x N, row-major).\n// Uses i-k-j order so the inner loop is contiguous and vectorizes, with four\n// rows of C updated per pass over B and k tiled for cache reuse. Each C element\n// still accumulates its k terms in ascending order, as in the naive triple loop.\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t rows, const size_t N) {\n    constexpr size_t kTile = 256;\n\n    std::fill(C.begin(), C.begin() + rows * N, 0.0);\n    for (size_t kk = 0; kk < N; kk += kTile) {\n        const size_t kEnd = std::min(kk + kTile, N);\n        size_t i = 0;\n        for (; i + 4 <= rows; i += 4) {\n            double* c0 = &C[(i + 0) * N];\n            double* c1 = &C[(i + 1) * N];\n            double* c2 = &C[(i + 2) * N];\n            double* c3 = &C[(i + 3) * N];\n            for (size_t k = kk; k < kEnd; ++k) {\n                const double a0 = A[(i + 0) * N + k];\n                const double a1 = A[(i + 1) * N + k];\n                const double a2 = A[(i + 2) * N + k];\n                const double a3 = A[(i + 3) * N + k];\n                const double* b = &B[k * N];\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    c0[j] += a0 * b[j];\n                    c1[j] += a1 * b[j];\n                    c2[j] += a2 * b[j];\n                    c3[j] += a3 * b[j];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for (; i < rows; ++i) {\n            double* c = &C[i * N];\n            for (size_t k = kk; k < kEnd; ++k) {\n                const double a = A[i * N + k];\n                const double* b = &B[k * N];\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    c[j] += a * b[j];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Simple validation: compute a single element and compare\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& B, const std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    // Check a few random positions\n    constexpr size_t checkPoints[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4};\n\n    for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n        for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n            const size_t i = checkPoints[pi] % N;\n            const size_t j = checkPoints[pj] % N;\n\n            double expected = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += getPseudoRndValue(N, i, k) * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n\n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n\n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Only the root gathers the full C matrix, needed for -r and -v (MPI counts are int)\n    const bool gather = printResults || validate;\n    if (gather && N * N > static_cast<size_t>(INT_MAX)) {\n        if (root) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Matrix size %zu too large to gather with -r/-v\\n\", N);\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Each rank holds its row block of A and C, plus a full copy of B\n    const RowBlock block = rowBlock(N, rank, size);\n    std::vector<double> A(block.count * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C(block.count * N);\n\n    initMatrix(A, N, block.start, block.count);\n    initMatrix(B, N, 0, N);\n\n    // Perform matrix multiplication\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    matrixMultiply(A, B, C, block.count, N);\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    // The parallel run takes as long as its slowest rank\n    long long localNs = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(end - start).count();\n    long long maxNs = 0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localNs, &maxNs, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Gather the full C matrix on the root\n    std::vector<double> fullC;\n    if (gather) {\n        if (root) {\n            fullC.resize(N * N);\n        }\n        std::vector<int> counts(size);\n }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Simple validation: compute a single element and compare\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& B, const std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    // Check a relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1ih29Sp2zt6YcucqJa7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The matmul benchmark now runs under MPI unconditionally. The output matches the original bit-for-bit across 63 combinations of matrix size and rank count, and it runs about 16× faster on one rank and near-linearly up to 64 ranks at N=1024.\n\nThe changes are in `matmul/matmul.cpp` and `matmul/CMakeLists.txt`. No other files were added or modified. I built out-of-tree in `/tmp`, so the repo has no build artifacts.\n\n**The one thing to know first:** I added `-ffp-contract=off` to the compile flags. Without it, the original's output is not stable: its hash changes with how the compiler vectorizes. The output also depended on the rank count, which a distributed benchmark can't allow. With the flag, every multiply and add rounds separately, as `sum += a*b` reads. This means the new binary matches the original *built with that flag*. It does not match the original's default build, for example at N=5 the hash is `e9fc4499f8c4acec` instead of `996ea9706c9633f4`. If you compare against default-build hashes, they will differ.\n\n**Design**\n- Rank `r` owns a contiguous block of rows of A and C. Each rank holds a full copy of B, which it generates locally, so no broadcast is needed.\n- The timed region is bracketed by a barrier, and the reported time is the maximum across ranks.\n- The full C matrix is gathered to rank 0 only when `-r` or `-v` needs it.\n- Output and validation run on rank 0. Its exit status is broadcast, so every rank exits with the same code.\n- The kernel is now i-k-j order with 4-row blocking and k-tiling. Each element still accumulates its k terms in ascending order.\n- `validateResult` recomputes A values with `getPseudoRndValue` instead of receiving the full A matrix.\n\n**Verification**\n- `-r` output (including the hash) matched the original for N in {1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 64, 97, 300, 513} and ranks in {1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 16}, which covers N not divisible by the rank count and N smaller than it.\n- `-v` passes at several sizes and rank counts. N=0 runs, an unknown option exits with status 1, and `-h` prints usage.\n- Build is clean with `-Wall -Wextra`.\n\n**Performance** (N=1024, single node, 256 cores, `--oversubscribe`)\n\n| Ranks | Compute time | GFLOPS |\n|---|---|---|\n| Original serial | 7869 ms | 0.27 |\n| 1 | 484 ms | 4.4 |\n| 4 | 122 ms | 17.6 |\n| 16 | 55 ms | 39.0 |\n| 64 | 12 ms | 179 |\n\n**Limits**\n- Each rank holds a full copy of B, so per-rank memory is O(N²). Rank 0 additionally holds the full C when `-r` or `-v` is used.\n- `-r` and `-v` are limited to N×N ≤ INT_MAX, because MPI gather counts are `int`.\n- This is pure MPI with one thread per rank. I did not add OpenMP.\n- I could only test on one node, so multi-node behaviour is untested."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":845,"cache_read_input_tokens":56830,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":845},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9e4b1553-e8d5-40fe-8819-46735e310be0","uuid":"2dcddcd8-06aa-41da-967a-7e491c29dcfe","timestamp":"2026-10-14T07:16:43.902Z","request_id":"req_011Cg1ih1sZeirSkP4ZVeQNM"}

If you compare against default-build hashes, they will differ.\n\n**Design**\n- Rank `r` owns a contiguous block of rows of A and C. Each rank holds a full copy of B, which it generates locally, so no broadcast is needed.\n- The timed region is bracketed by a barrier, and the reported time is the maximum across ranks.\n- The full C matrix is gathered to rank 0 only when `-r` or `-v` needs it.\n- Output and validation run on rank 0. Its exit status is broadcast, so every rank exits with the same code.\n- The kernel is now i-k-j order with 4-row blocking and k-tiling. Each element still accumulates its k terms in ascending order.\n- `validateResult` recomputes A values with `getPseudoRndValue` instead of receiving the full A matrix.\n\n**Verification**\n- `-r` output (including the hash) matched the original for N in {1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 64, 97, 300, 513} and ranks in {1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 16}, which covers N not divisible by the rank count and N smaller than it.\n- `-v` passes at several sizes and rank counts. N=0 runs, an unknown option exits with status 1, and `-h` prints usage.\n- Build is clean with `-Wall -Wextra`.\n\n**Performance** (N=1024, single node, 256 cores, `--oversubscribe`)\n\n| Ranks | Compute time | GFLOPS |\n|---|---|---|\n| Original serial | 7869 ms | 0.27 |\n| 1 | 484 ms | 4.4 |\n| 4 | 122 ms | 17.6 |\n| 16 | 55 ms | 39.0 |\n| 64 | 12 ms | 179 |\n\n**Limits**\n- Each rank holds a full copy of B, so per-rank memory is O(N²). Rank 0 additionally holds the full C when `-r` or `-v` is used.\n- `-r` and `-v` are limited to N×N ≤ INT_MAX, because MPI gather counts are `int`.\n- This is pure MPI with one thread per rank.
